Sentence (English): After buying a Samsung fridge a few years ago out of necessity, it was time to match the other appliances.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well and quiet ] || ---------------- || After buying a Samsung fridge a few years ago out of necessity, it was time to match the other appliances. I read a lot of reviews before making my purchase and felt some apprehension due to all of the NEGATIVE reviews. I liked the thought of a third rack and the auto opening feature. I also liked what was said about how quiet the cycles are. Well I've discovered that the third rack isn't that much of a feature. I've found that the interior has less space than my old dishwasher- I'm unable to wash small sheet pans or tall cups in upper rack. A small drawback, but disappointing nonetheless. And mobile functions aren't the best either. I'm able to send cycle settings to dishwasher but not start it remotely. I like how quiet it is and have been pleased with how it's cleaned the dishes. I've only had it for a month and so far no other complaints.

Honestly almost every time I open the thing and slide the middle rack out, it falls off. The collapsible tines on the bottom don't work because they hook into a plastic clasp that grips the bottom rack. Guess what broke from a slightly too hard adjustment. The plastic clasp. For $800, it sure is cheap. You can do better. Look elsewhere.

Sentence (English): I had to replace by 12 year old Maytag dishwasher and went with the Samsung for price (it was on sale), third row silverware tray, and for the time being displayed on the front (it's the little things that make me happy).From a washing perspective, it's amazing.
Comments (English): [ Cleans better than I ever expected. ] || ---------------- || I had to replace by 12 year old Maytag dishwasher and went with the Samsung for price (it was on sale), third row silverware tray, and for the time being displayed on the front (it's the little things that make me happy).From a washing perspective, it's amazing. I put a pot with dried pasta sauce (with cheese) dried to on the inside and to my surprise, it came out sparkling clean. Everything seems to come out cleaner than ever before. Noise wise, it's so quite, you won't realize it's running unless you look at the timer on the front or put your hand on it to feel the little vibration. The timer is probably the most indespensible part. Most washers you have to guess at the time remaining but this lets you know (plus there's the app). The top rack is great and I like it better than the normal silverware holder because it also frees up some space on the lower rack but there is a cost. The middle rack only goes up so far so taller things turn into a trade off between the bottom and middle rack which isn't optimal. in the lower position, you can't put tall utensils in the bottom holder or the middle sprayer gets stuck. NOt a huge issue but still could be better. overall, it does a great job and would recommend.

Sentence (English): I was expecting to be really wowed by this Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Decent Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I was expecting to be really wowed by this Bosch dishwasher. And it is a very good machine. There are some things though that are just a little annoying that I had expected would be better based on all of the reviews. First, this dishwasher was one made in Germany that were sent over due to the pandemic supply chain shortages. The dishwasher is supposed to be uber quiet at 42bd and it is fine but I think a bit louder than my former so-so LG dishwasher. The upper adjustable rack is great because you can lower it and put wine glasses on top or raise it and put trays on the bottom. This Bosch has crystal dry which does a very good job drying dishes and plastic but leaves the stainless steel drum completely wet. You cannot leave the door open just a bit to let it air dry - the door either has to be fully open or it will close. The more expensive Miele has a feature where the door pops open at the end of the drying cycle. I believe the Bosch 500 does that as well but does not have crystal dry. Lastly, I had heard that Bosch cleans pots really, really well. I had used Auto for a cycle a couple of times with pots on the bottom and glasses and bowls on top and I would say it would fully clean some of the time, sometimes there were dried pieces of food on the pots (glasses were clean). The tines on the bottom rack are not adjustable, so if you have frying pans, thick dishes or trays, they are hard to fit into the times. Is it a good dishwasher - yes. Is it worth the cost, I am not fully sure. It would be great to actually test drive different brands in advance. You have to rely on reviews and hope for the best!

Comments (English): [ Solid Dishwasher, no problems ] || ---------------- || This KitchenAid dishwasher replaces a 24-year old Whirlpool dishwasher that was an integral part of the family. (I paid too much for too many features that I didn't use on that old machine, but boy was it worth every penny in longevity and performance.) I'm still figuring out how to load this new KitchenAid machine with my dishes, that fit so perfectly in my previous machine. I love the tall tub--it makes me feel okay about stacking dishes double deep on the middle rack because things don't fit quite as nicely as I would like. I wish the rows for glasses were a few millimeters wider so small prep bowls would lay flat. I also wish the rows down the center (where I would love to stack bowls) had a "flat" base rather than slanted one, which makes stacking my bowls there an impossibility because they roll to one side or the other. I can't say that I love the third-level utensil rack, but I don't hate it. I sometimes still forget it's there when I unload. It's easier for me to load silverware and utensils in the lower basket because it has plenty of space, but I do load knives in the third rack. Only very low-profile utensils fit up there--no measuring cups or little mise en place bowls, etc. I'm still getting used to the lower tine spacing and arrangement. They seem to be just enough closer together that bowls and things don't fit quite like I am used to. Also, they don't seem quite as sturdy as in my previous machine. (But then again, I didn't spend an equivalent amount on this new machine.) This dishwasher does a fabulous job of getting things clean. I alternate use of detergent pods and powder (that I am still trying to use up). The detergent drawer seems solid and operates well. The stainless steel interior still looks great (I have soft water). It is so quiet when operating that I have to put my ear near the door to hear it. I almost always run the Express Wash cycle, which still takes a minimum of 90 minutes. I don't use heated drying, and the dishes are mostly dry in the morning, but not totally. (Condensed water vapor still clings to the door in the morning.) I prefer to pop open the door to let them completely dry--I live in a desert so it works great and we need the humidity in the house. We've had this for about 4 months now and I have no complaints. (HD delivered this one--great service. My husband removed the old one and installed this new one.) The "owner's manual" leaves a bit to be desired. It has minimal, at best, descriptions of cycles and detergent and rinse agent use and filter cleaning and such. But then again, I'm probably one of the few people who actually read things like that!

Sentence (English): I read reviews on many dishwashers, and Bosch was always out in front.
Comments (English): [ My new Bosch ] || ---------------- || I read reviews on many dishwashers, and Bosch was always out in front. Finally, I have one! I was slow to install it as my old dishwasher was hardwired and the new ones are not. that meant waiting for an electrician to make the necessary adjustments. The machine is now installed, I have not used it a lot yet. My first load was a pretty mixed load. every piece of cutlery I owned was in the 3rd rack. Glasses, coffee mugs, plastic storage and greasy frying pan in the other racks. I chose the auto setting which is just over 2 hours. EVERYTHING came out perfectly clean. some items had water droplets. I thought maybe things could have been drier. Perhaps, if the machine sat a little longer after the cycle was over. items were very warm, almost hot, so I think I happened to go thru the kitchen within minutes of the cycle finishing. The 3rd rack is AMAZING. love that idea! Plastics are hard to dry, next time I am running a load with a lot of plastic, I will select the extra dry option.I installed this machine by myself after the electrician changed out the wiring for me. The QR codes that directed you to videos for levelling were well done, the manual did not cover it enough for me. Installing the stabilizing clips was a little confusing, youtube was helpful. the machine is now very solid.Functionality - Love, Love it, and it is VERY quiet as advertised. The first time I pressed the on button and closed the door, I was not sure if the machine was even running.

I am now stuck with an expensive dishwasher that doesn't work.Bosch has lost a loyal customer. They will lose more money from that than they saved by refusing to fix this one product.

Sentence (English): This KitchenAid dishwasher replaces a 24-year old Whirlpool dishwasher that was an integral part of the family. (
Comments (English): [ Solid Dishwasher, no problems ] || ---------------- || This KitchenAid dishwasher replaces a 24-year old Whirlpool dishwasher that was an integral part of the family. (I paid too much for too many features that I didn't use on that old machine, but boy was it worth every penny in longevity and performance.) I'm still figuring out how to load this new KitchenAid machine with my dishes, that fit so perfectly in my previous machine. I love the tall tub--it makes me feel okay about stacking dishes double deep on the middle rack because things don't fit quite as nicely as I would like. I wish the rows for glasses were a few millimeters wider so small prep bowls would lay flat. I also wish the rows down the center (where I would love to stack bowls) had a \"flat\" base rather than slanted one, which makes stacking my bowls there an impossibility because they roll to one side or the other. I can't say that I love the third-level utensil rack, but I don't hate it. I sometimes still forget it's there when I unload. It's easier for me to load silverware and utensils in the lower basket because it has plenty of space, but I do load knives in the third rack. Only very low-profile utensils fit up there--no measuring cups or little mise en place bowls, etc. I'm still getting used to the lower tine spacing and arrangement. They seem to be just enough closer together that bowls and things don't fit quite like I am used to. Also, they don't seem quite as sturdy as in my previous machine. (But then again, I didn't spend an equivalent amount on this new machine.) This dishwasher does a fabulous job of getting things clean. I alternate use of detergent pods and powder (that I am still trying to use up). The detergent drawer seems solid and operates well. The stainless steel interior still looks great (I have soft water). It is so quiet when operating that I have to put my ear near the door to hear it. I almost always run the Express Wash cycle, which still takes a minimum of 90 minutes. I don't use heated drying, and the dishes are mostly dry in the morning, but not totally. (Condensed water vapor still clings to the door in the morning.) I prefer to pop open the door to let them completely dry--I live in a desert so it works great and we need the humidity in the house. We've had this for about 4 months now and I have no complaints. (HD delivered this one--great service. My husband removed the old one and installed this new one.) The \"owner's manual\" leaves a bit to be desired. It has minimal, at best, descriptions of cycles and detergent and rinse agent use and filter cleaning and such. But then again, I'm probably one of the few people who actually read things like that!

Sentence (English): The appliance is very nice, I think it is what would stand out the most.
Comments (English): [ Very nice, one pass the built-in display! ] || ---------------- || The appliance is very nice, I think it is what would stand out the most. Both the touch and the color are very elegant. The built-in "screen" is very unobtrusive, and the touch control works well. Regarding cleaning, it should be noted that using low-quality tablets achieves very good results, with top-brand tablets it is impeccable. The drying process in the intensive program is outrageous, you even have to leave it open and cool down for a few minutes because it is impossible to take the dishes fresh out. Of course, it dries and disinfects absolutely everything you put in. As for noise, it is normal, on the low side. If you are very close you can hear it but as soon as you leave the kitchen you don't notice it. The configuration of trays and cutlery is modifiable to a certain extent, being able to move and configure them for each situation. Very easy to modify. In general I think it is a very good machine for the price it has.
Comments (Original): [ Muy bonito, una pasada el display incorporado! ] || ---------------- || El electrodoméstico es muy bonito, creo que es lo que más destacaría. Tanto el tacto como el color quedan muy elegantes. La 'pantalla' incorporada es muy discreta y el control táctil funciona correctamente. En cuanto a limpieza, destacar que usando pastillas de baja calidad consigue unos muy buenos resultados, con pastillas de primeras marcas es impecable. El proceso de secado en el programa intensivo es una barbaridad, incluso tienes que dejarlo abierto y enfriando unos minutos porque es imposible coger la vajilla recién salida. Desde luego que seca y desinfecta absolutamente todo lo que metas.En cuanto a tema ruido es normal, tirando a bajo. Si estás muy cerca se oye pero en cuanto sales de la cocina no se nota. La configuración de bandejas y cubertera es modificable en cierta medida, pudiendo moverlas y configurarlas para cada situación. Muy cómoda de modificar.En general creo que es una muy buena máquina por el precio que tiene.

Comments (English): [ My new Bosch ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) I read reviews on many dishwashers, and Bosch was always out in front. Finally, I have one! I was slow to install it as my old dishwasher was hardwired and the new ones are not. that meant waiting for an electrician to make the necessary adjustments. The machine is now installed, I have not used it a lot yet. My first load was a pretty mixed load. every piece of cutlery I owned was in the 3rd rack. Glasses, coffee mugs, plastic storage and greasy frying pan in the other racks. I chose the auto setting which is just over 2 hours. EVERYTHING came out perfectly clean. some items had water droplets. I thought maybe things could have been drier. Perhaps, if the machine sat a little longer after the cycle was over. items were very warm, almost hot, so I think I happened to go thru the kitchen within minutes of the cycle finishing. The 3rd rack is AMAZING. love that idea! Plastics are hard to dry, next time I am running a load with a lot of plastic, I will select the extra dry option. I installed this machine by myself after the electrician changed out the wiring for me. The QR codes that directed you to videos for levelling were well done, the manual did not cover it enough for me. Installing the stabilizing clips was a little confusing, youtube was helpful. the machine is now very solid. Functionality - Love, Love it, and it is VERY quiet as advertised. Sentence (English): (This review was received through a promotion.)
Comments (English): [ Very nice, one pass the built-in display! ] || ---------------- || (This review was received through a promotion.) The appliance is very nice, I think that is what would stand out the most. Both the touch and the color are very elegant. The built-in "screen" is very unobtrusive, and the touch control works well. Regarding cleaning, it should be noted that using low-quality tablets achieves very good results, with top-brand tablets it is impeccable. The drying process in the intensive program is outrageous, you even have to leave it open and cool down for a few minutes because it is impossible to take the dishes fresh out. Of course, it dries and disinfects absolutely everything you put in. As for noise, it is normal, on the low side. If you are very close you can hear it but as soon as you leave the kitchen you don't notice it. The configuration of trays and cutlery is modifiable to a certain extent, being able to move and configure them for each situation. Very easy to modify. In general I think it is a very good machine for the price it has.
Comments (Original): [ Muy bonito, una pasada el display incorporado! ] || ---------------- || (Esta reseña se ha recibido a través de una promoción.) El electrodoméstico es muy bonito, creo que es lo que más destacaría. Tanto el tacto como el color quedan muy elegantes. La 'pantalla' incorporada es muy discreta y el control táctil funciona correctamente. En cuanto a limpieza, destacar que usando pastillas de baja calidad consigue unos muy buenos resultados, con pastillas de primeras marcas es impecable. El proceso de secado en el programa intensivo es una barbaridad, incluso tienes que dejarlo abierto y enfriando unos minutos porque es imposible coger la vajilla recién salida. Desde luego que seca y desinfecta absolutamente todo lo que metas.En cuanto a tema ruido es normal, tirando a bajo. Si estás muy cerca se oye pero en cuanto sales de la cocina no se nota. La configuración de bandejas y cubertera es modificable en cierta medida, pudiendo moverlas y configurarlas para cada situación. Muy cómoda de modificar.En general creo que es una muy buena máquina por el precio que tiene.

Comments (English): [ Think before buy a third rack machine. ] || ---------------- || I like the controls, they seem solid. Still learning how to load the machine with the third rack. We had a standard two rack machine before. While this machine looks like it will hold more, you have to know which of your dishes will work best in the machine. The bottom rack is not as tall as our previous model, so some of the bigger dishes need to be more at an angle. Tall glasses can only go on one side of the second rack as the top rack hangs down on one side. I'm not sure the top rack provides great value for the space, but we will see.I installed it myself, and was surprised how different it was from the KitchenAide it was replacing. There are no wheels in the back like the earlier model and the instructions don't tell you you will need to adjust the height in the back prior to sliding it in. Also, the side or top mounting brackets are cheap an flimsy. My previous KitchenAide had better side mounting brackets as they were part of the cabinet, these are not. Lastly, I didn't buy the installation kit as I was replacing one KitchenAide for another however, the connection for the water was different and required a separate trip to Lowes. I will confess, the online order told me I would need the installation kit but I didn't order it. This actually worked out better because I was able to find just the connection for $6 rather than spend the $34 for the kit. I was able to reuse the water line and the electrical cord.

Comments (English): [ Purchase in haste, repent at leisure ] || ---------------- || I thought a dishwasher is just a dishwasher and any would do. How wrong I was! As another reviewer mentioned, the non-existent exterior light indicating cycle completion is a major deal-breaker. When purchasing this Bosch, I didn't realize this feature was missing. Also, although I measured and the dishwasher fit into my space, I didn't take into account the shorter depth of this Bosch, which makes the interior much smaller with less capacity. I thought I was being over-critical until my teenage daughter opened it yesterday and exclaimed, "This is SO small! " I also didn't realize that there is no dry feature. I have come to depend on the dishes being dry when I go to unload the dishwasher. I purchased this dishwasher online and rather quickly as ours was broken and I was mainly just looking for the correct width and height as well as only having 2 racks. I don't love the 3rd rack feature on most dishwashers these days but may have to go with it to find a better dishwasher. I will choose more carefully this second time around. I will be reading them before I make my next purchase.)

Sentence (English): We replaced our old Bosch dishwasher that served us for 15 years and was still working but because of the age decided it was time.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 Series Towel Rack Handle ] || ---------------- || We replaced our old Bosch dishwasher that served us for 15 years and was still working but because of the age decided it was time. The choice was easy another Bosch, this time the 800 series with the towel handle. All we can say is Bosch hit a home run with the 800 series. It is very quiet and it cleans the dishes and silverware leaving them like new. It also cleans plastic just as good. We are really impressed with the drying of the Bosch 800 series as it really does dry plastic as good as they say it does. After you are using the dishwasher I recommend the door be left cracked open so it does not get musty. When you leave the door cracked open it allows the dishwasher to breathe. You will need to press the off indicator so it does not flash the display on the top of the door. We were happy with our 15 year old Bosch dishwasher but this new 800 series is even better. The install was easy and straight forward. One word of caution is Bosch uses a 3/4 inch water intake fitting, think of your garden hose. You will need to purchase a 90 degree dishwasher elbow at a hardware store. You need the 3/8 inch X 3/4 inch dishwasher elbow. Once you have the dishwasher elbow the install is easy and you can do it in about 30 minutes. We highly recommend the Bosch 800 series dishwasher.

Comments (English): [ Very satisfied after a few months. ] || ---------------- || [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] The 3 baskets offer lots of space and lots of possibilities. The MyWay basket is very versatile. I can leave it a day later than my old one. Washing is very efficient and the jets powerful in the "Auto" cycle. Everything comes out clean without rinsing. Some plastic items turn over when washing, whereas in my old dishwasher, this was not the case. Relatively silent. Very effective "CrystalDry" drying to dry all the drops of water from the plastics and the dishes are hot if you want to empty it as soon as the cycle is finished. The metal basket of the lower basket leaves marks in the metal inside the door (rubbing mark). Comments (English): [ Bosch Series 300 Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || (This review was collected as part of a promotion.) This dishwasher was installed easily by me and is for my elderly mother. It is made in Germany which has two important safety features that stop the dishwasher when leaks are detected. One of these will stop the inlet water from going into the dishwasher. It has the three racks and in of them is for cutlery.(the top rack) You can adjust the height of the other rack to accommodate larger pots, pans and be able to place one side of the racks at an angle. The other feature I like is the door will close once you release it at a certain point. Not many dishwashers are able to perform this task. It closes nicely and securely Control Buttons are easy to see and use. I personally have a series 809 dishwasher for a few years now that has been reliable. And would recommend either one of these series. Some other manufacturers dishwashers that are stainless do not truly have a solid stainless steel door but combine them with some type of plastic which looks like stainless. The series 300 or 800 is truly a solid stainless panel through out.

Sentence (English): My younger sibling moved into a new house and wanted to have a dishwasher, so I ordered it right away because I could choose it through the Coupang Experience Group.
Comments (English): My younger sibling moved into a new house and wanted to have a dishwasher, so I ordered it right away because I could choose it through the Coupang Experience Group. I was worried if I ordered it right because the reviews were not good, but I thought I made a good choice after getting it installed and using it. I coordinated the time with the installer the next day after ordering it, and he came right on the scheduled installation date. Since there was an existing water purifier line, the line fit perfectly into the hole that was drilled a little loosely, so I didn't have to drill a hole separately. However, the line wasn't thick, so I didn't have to drill a big hole when drilling it. I was grateful that he finished the installation and explained how to use it well. I wanted to give him full marks for his kindness. I installed it on the sink, and it wasn't too big, so I think it'll fit most of it. I think more dishes can fit inside than I thought. Reviews say that it doesn't hold many dishes, but it holds a lot more than the 6-person, 2-tier dishwasher that I'm using. It's easy to arrange the dishes and make good use of the space. It's really good in terms of functionality, and it has 7 functions, including a reservation function, automatic cleaning, and an eco function, so it saves a lot of power. It seemed economical, but if there's one thing I regret, it's that there's no window on the front to see inside, so there's no way to check if it's being washed well. There's no automatic lid opening function, so I have to open it after washing. Still, there are more advantages than disadvantages, so it seems like a really good product for the price. Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher after looking at multiple machines.
Comments (English): [ Extremely quiet and it's customizable! ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher after looking at multiple machines. A recessed handle and controls on top of the door were the top two features I was most looking for. I find the controls work very well with just a finger touch. I'm still getting used to not putting mythumb on the top of the door when opening and closing the door in between cycles but I'm sure it won't take long to remember not to touch the control panel. Both the bottom and middle drawers have portions of the racks that can be adjusted to suit the types of dishes and glassware being washed. The small third rack is perfect for small items that used to end up on the bottom of my old dishwasher. My dishes get very clean, I have no complaints about the cleaning ability of this machine. In addition I find the exterior is staying clean and not showing and fingerprints which is a huge thing for me! The final point that swayed my decision to this machine was the noise level. There was another dishwasher that was very similar to this one but the decibels were much higher. I only paid a small amount extra for this machine and I am very pleased with how quiet it is! If you are standing directly in front of it while it is running there is no need to raise your voice at all during a conversation. If I am in the next room it is almost impossible to hear it running! Overall I am extremely satisfied and highly recommend it!

Sentence (English): We've had the dishwasher for almost 3 months and are happy so far.
Comments (English): [ Love the dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We've had the dishwasher for almost 3 months and are happy so far. It's not quite as quiet as I had expected, but is certainly not noisy. It cleans well with no pre-rinsing and dries everything well except glasses/cups with large recesses on the bottom where water pools. The 3rd rack is a nice feature. The delivery and setup from Costco were really amazing. They were on time and in and out in no time. Hauled away the old dishwasher and ran a test cycle in the new one before leaving. One thing to note is the top controls. Our countertop hangs over the cabinet so we cannot see the controls when the door is closed. Not an issue really, just can't see the time left display. Still, highly recommend.

But that's not enough for me.

Might need to ask bosch which salt to buy for the dispenser.
